name: Eye Pricing API
Eye Opportunity Before Validate
script:
# Opportunity · Before Validate: locks requirements Production started on, recalculates the costing and the pricing status.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_before_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Opportunity Before Save
script:
# Opportunity · Before Save: Quotation stage needs a quotation; Project Won needs pricing done and items above the minimum.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Opportunity After Save
script:
# Opportunity · After Save: a request Production has not started follows the requirements.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request Before Save
script:
# Pricing Request · Before Save: who may change the costs now, cost totals per line.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request After Insert
script:
# Pricing Request · After Insert: assigns the request to Production.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_after_insert", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request After Save
script:
# Pricing Request · After Save: first cost starts the pricing; edits before Sales starts flow to the deal.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request Before Delete
script:
# Pricing Request · Before Delete: only an unstarted request can be deleted.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_on_trash", doc=doc)

name: Eye Quotation Before Save
script:
# Quotation · Before Save: pricing must be done and the net total above the minimum.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="q_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Quotation After Save
script:
# Quotation · After Save: saving a quotation moves the deal to Quotation.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="q_on_update", doc=doc)
